item.title: Don't discontinue Gemini 2.5 Flash
item.description:
📝 Nick_D July 10, 2026, 12:13am 1 Hi Everyone - Firstly, I want to give my thanks to the Gemini team for providing access to such great models. We have some very specific workflows that rely on Gemini 2. Our internal benchmarks show that Gemini 3 flash does not perform as well (even after attempting to tweak prompting following the new prompting guidelines and other changes).
🔗 Read more: https://discuss.ai.google.dev/t/please-dont-discontinue-gemini-2-5-flash/174246
